title: Companion quarrel dialogue sometimes labels a choice as 'back Tamsin -- the barrow should hold' immediately after I had already acted (left the doors open) moments earlier in the same scene, so the option reads as re-litigating a decision already made rather than a fresh stance, which was momentarily disorienting.
